# Module Name

## Responsibility

Describe the behavior owned by this module and the behavior explicitly outside its scope.

## Dependencies

List allowed Core modules and external packages. WPF types are forbidden in every Core module.

## Thread Model

State callers, execution context, synchronization, cancellation, and shutdown expectations.

## Invariants

- Record ownership, ordering, loss, memory, and lifecycle rules that implementations must preserve.

## Test Strategy

List unit, property, fuzz, load, and hardware tests required for this module.
